name: alignment irregularity
definition_zh: 轨道沿线路方向的横向几何不平顺。
usage_note: alignment irregularity 用于轨道不平顺语境，不宜将其他语境中的“方向”一律译为 alignment。
usage_overview: 作为轨道平面内横向几何偏差形成的激励，主要用于横向振动、轮轨接触及状态预测分析，常与轨距不平顺联合考虑；与高低不平顺所表示的竖向几何偏差应分别处理。

complete_examples.text: Compared to the wheel–rail vertical force, the factors c1 and krp; z have little influence on wheel–rail lateral force, instead, the track alignment irregularity c2 takes the governing role in determining the wheel–rail lateral force; moreover, track cross-level and gauge irregularity, namely, c3 and c4 are also non-negligible factors affecting the wheel–rail lateral interactions.
And ηv, ηc, ηg, ηa are used to indicate the vertical profile irregularity, cross level irregularity, gauge irregularity and alignment irregularity of the track, respectively.
The variation of track geometry is divided into vertical irregularity (vertical profile and cross level irregularity) and transverse irregularity (gauge and alignment irregularity).
